prompt: This .NET 10 API still uses older C# syntax and manual backing fields. Modernize the code to idiomatic C# 14 where it clearly improves readability.
assertions: The response recommends C# 14 as the default baseline for a supported .NET 10 project.
The response mentions at least one relevant C# 14 feature such as field-backed properties, null-conditional assignment, nameof for unbound generics, or extension blocks.
The response avoids blanket churn and distinguishes useful modernization from pointless syntax changes.
